Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-004 Connected receipt upload and authorized receipt access

parameters.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'New Expense' navigation item in the LEFT sidebar under the EMPLOYEE section, directly below 'My Expenses' and above the MANAGER section; it is the form route, not the current EXP-1037 detail page.

parameters.script: const el=document.querySelector('input[id$="-description"]'); if(!el) return {ok:false,reason:'description field not found'}; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) return {ok:false,reason:'description setter not found'}; setter.call(el,'EFREG004-Receipt-Variant'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,id:el.id,value:el.value};

const el=document.querySelector('input[type="number"]'); if(!el) return {ok:false,reason:'amount field not found'}; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) return {ok:false,reason:'amount setter not found'}; setter.call(el,'1251'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,id:el.id,value:el.value,valid:el.checkValidity()};

const el=document.querySelector('input[type="date"]'); if(!el) return {ok:false,reason:'date field not found'}; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) return {ok:false,reason:'date setter not found'}; setter.call(el,'2026-08-23'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,id:el.id,value:el.value,valid:el.checkValidity()};

const input=document.querySelector('input[type="file"]'); const label=input?.closest('label'); if(!input||!label) return {ok:false,reason:'receipt label not found'}; label.click(); return {ok:true,labelText:(label.innerText||'').trim(),inputId:input.id};

parameters.elementDescription: The medium-sized dashed 'Upload receipt' file-input area in the CENTER-RIGHT of the New expense form, directly below the Date field and to the right of the date input; it shows a paperclip icon and the helper text 'Uploaded to the ExpenseFlow_Receipts storage bucket on submit.'

parameters.script: const input=document.querySelector('input[type="file"]'); if(!input) return {ok:false,reason:'file input not found'}; input.click(); return {ok:true,id:input.id,accept:input.accept};

parameters.elementDescription: The file-list row labeled 'EFREG004 receipt #1 (copy).pdf' in the CENTER-LEFT of the Open dialog, directly below the 'manual-run-20260924T093500' folder and directly above 'efreg004-receipt.pdf'; this is the fresh synthetic special-character PDF, not the folder or the original receipt.

The large blue 'Submit Expense' button in the BOTTOM-RIGHT of the New expense form card, directly to the right of the white Cancel button and below the selected 'EFREG004 receipt #1 (copy).pdf' file area; this is the form submission control, not a navigation link.

parameters.script: return {url:location.href, banner:(document.body.innerText||'').split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).filter(s=>/submitted for|open the expense|dashboard/i.test(s)).slice(0,10), form:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input,select')).map(el=>({type:el.type,id:el.id,value:el.type==='file'?'[file-input]':el.value})).slice(0,8), links:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).map(a=>({text:(a.innerText||'').trim(),href:a.href})).filter(x=>/open the expense|dashboard/i.test(x.text))};

parameters.elementDescription: The underlined 'open the expense' link in the green success banner near the LOWER-CENTER of the New expense form, immediately after 'See it on your dashboard or' and below the receipt upload area; this link opens the newly submitted EXP-1038 record, not the Dashboard link.

The small rounded receipt button labeled 'EFREG004-receipt-1-copy-.pdf' in the CENTER of the EXP-1038 expense detail card, on the Receipt row between the Employee and Policy rows; it has a paperclip icon and an open icon, and its tooltip identifies the ExpenseFlow_Receipts bucket.
